title: ASX slides for second week amid sell-off in local banks
excerpt: High oil prices, US bond market concerns and a sell-off in local banks drove the index lower.
body:
Sydney Morning Herald published this story this week. Headline: ASX slides for second week amid sell-off in local banks.

We pulled the headline and summary so you can decide whether it's worth reading in full. The original article is linked at the top of this brief.
